expectedText: Did you visit the two apartments in the Riverside neighborhood, Omar? Yes. The Pine Street apartment has a monthly rent of 650 pounds. The Cedar Street one costs 690. Which one is more spacious? Pine has the bigger bedroom, but the kitchen is smaller than Cedar's. The bathroom is private in both places. Does Pine have any furniture? Yes, a sofa and a small table. I checked the floor and took a picture of a stain on the ceiling. The wall is a pale color. There was no leak near the window when I visited. What did the landlord say about heating? Heating uses electricity. The electricity charge is included in the rent, and there is no gas supply in that apartment. Did you ask about the deposit and the lease?
